items.summary: One of the great mysteries of capitalism is the nature of the "firm". It's a question that is near and dear to my heart as someone that's been "doing startups" for the last six years, and almost every startup founder has considered it whether they realize it or not. There are two ways of asking The Mystery of the Firm, depending on your initial inclination.
